_comment: Companies whose fiscal year does not end in December, by symbol. endMonth is the month (1-12) the fiscal year ends in; Argaam numbers their quarters and years within that fiscal year. import-quarterly-workbook.py copies these into dist/<slug>-quarterly-financials.json. Companies not listed use a calendar year.
